description: Authored demo transcript for a close-out note on the CHW-R2 riser (Harbourfront One). Written for the offline demo: no audio was recorded and no recogniser produced it. Its recorded_extraction is an authored demo draft for exactly this transcript, so the demo note drafts the same rule every time; it is used only when the note is exactly this transcript.
transcript: Closed ISV-L23-CHW at 08:20, leak stopped within 5 minutes. Next time check the LD-23-04 cable first, it alarms before the ceiling shows any stain.

rule_candidates.title: On an L23 leak alarm, check the LD-23-04 leak-detection cable first
rule_candidates.decision: Check the LD-23-04 leak-detection cable first: it alarms before the ceiling shows any stain. If the leak is on the L23 chilled-water branch, close ISV-L23-CHW.
